name: Wonderla Holidays Limited
summary: Wonderla Holidays Limited operates amusement parks and resorts in India. The company operates through Amusement Parks and Resort, and Others segments. It also offers various land and water rides. In addition, it sells merchandise, cooked food, packed foods, beverages, etc. Further, the company operates restaurants, banquet halls, food courts, lounge bar, and hotel rooms. Wonderla Holidays Limited was founded in 2000 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
